title: Can the Azure workload carry peak traffic without hiding its cost drivers?
description: Choose a workload, change demand and failure-domain spread, then inspect capacity, failover headroom, and an illustrative monthly planning envelope.
disclaimer: The unit rates are transparent teaching assumptions, not an Azure quote. Replace them with the Azure Pricing Calculator, negotiated discounts, and measured telemetry before budgeting.

profiles.label: Internal business API
profiles.detail: Predictable weekday traffic with small responses and moderate audit logging.

profiles.label: Customer commerce API
profiles.detail: Bursty public traffic needs zone headroom, managed data, and visible request telemetry.

profiles.label: Media catalog
profiles.detail: Read-heavy traffic makes outbound bytes and cache strategy dominate the envelope.

commitments.label: On demand
commitments.detail: Maximum flexibility with no modeled compute commitment discount.
